assertions: Retrieves the list of changed files scoped to PR 123 (e.g. via gh pr view --json files) before scanning, rather than scanning the whole repo
Spawns parallel Explore agents (model haiku) covering the OWASP categories rather than scanning serially inline
Every reported finding includes a specific file path and line number plus an actual code snippet, not a placeholder
No code is modified, fixed, or committed — output is a report only
Scans the entire codebase rather than restricting to a diff/PR/commit
Uses an Explore agent to discover the technology stack (frameworks, DB, auth patterns) before scanning for vulnerabilities
Produces a markdown report with statistics: total vulnerabilities and counts by severity/category
Every finding is grouped under an OWASP Top 10:2025 category (A01-A10)
Does not invent vulnerabilities that weren't grep-verified and read in context
Focuses scanning on authentication, authorization, and rate-limiting related categories (A01, A07, A06) per the api scope definition
Does not exhaustively report unrelated categories (e.g. pure frontend XSS/CSP) as if they were in scope
Each finding cites file:line evidence and a code snippet
Report includes 2-3 fix recommendations per finding rather than a single fix with no alternatives
